targets.true_peak_method: 4x polyphase oversampling (scipy resample_poly), max of all channels
targets.loudness_method: ITU-R BS.1770-4 via pyloudnorm (integrated, gated); momentary = ungated 400 ms K-weighted windows, 10 ms hop

gains.note: master.wav = TP-limiter(G * voice.wav as dual mono, DC-blocked + music.wav + sfx.wav); the stems are written post-gain G (the level they have inside master.wav, before the limiter). master-no-narration.wav = TP-limiter(G * voice-worker.wav + Gb * (music ducked under W01 only + sfx)), Gb = no_narration_background_gain_db

analysis_before_ducking.tuning_method: per segment of 1.8 s or more: Hann FFT (5 s max, 4x zero padding), spectral peaks 120 to 2000 Hz within 24 dB of the strongest, grouped by nearest note, magnitude-weighted centre in cents (the pad's chorus spreads each note +-3.5 to 7 cents by design)

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Real work in the middle:

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: a worker, a site, a risk owner.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Priora places agents around it.

sentences.speaker: worker
sentences.text: Hey, the bracket by the packing line has cracked again. We're going to weld it before the night shift.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Priora hears a repair, hot work, a place and a deadline.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then it asks for a photo.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Next, it summons only the specialists this site and job need.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Each checks its own conditions and reports back.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: When everything holds, the route opens.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work goes on, the record is kept, no one is disturbed.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then one condition slips.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The fire watch is half what the policy asks.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Priora brings it to the risk owner.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Agents prepare; the human decides.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Three decision rooms open.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Retain is never a default.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Risk is kept on purpose, with its terms explicit.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Mitigate compares safeguards, and checks whether the work is back inside.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Transfer, simulated for now, asks outside capacity for terms and a price.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Priora carries the case between rooms.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The risk owner stays in control.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Priora turns physical work into explicit risk decisions, while the work happens.
